1.consolidated_definition: alim. Comida para llevar. Comida que se compra generalmente en una ventana especial de un restaurante de comida rápida. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. El local cuenta con servicio de carry out y delivery en Ocean Park e Isla Verde (Primera Hora, 27-07-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Food for take-out. Food that is typically purchased from a special window of a fast-food restaurant. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. The establishment offers carry out and delivery services in Ocean Park and Isla Verde (First Hour, 27-07-07)
